findings.description: F-004: the paired notebook 18-18's working example printed 'Элементов на холсте после нажатия: 0' although no press was ever simulated (no FakeEvent, no real click); `before` was computed and unused. The CREATE ONCE / UPDATE MANY TIMES claim was never demonstrated, only deferred to an unassessed starred task.
findings.resolution: Fixed in notebooks/chapter-18/18-18-zhivoe-prevyu.ipynb: swapped in the FakeEvent-aware preamble, added the FakeEvent class cell used elsewhere in the chapter, and rewrote the demo to call on_press once and on_drag eight times, printing the item count at each stage plus the preview coords, with a new 'Проверка результата' cell asserting the count is 1 after the press and still 1 after eight drags. Re-executed: 'Элементов на холсте после нажатия: 1 | Элементов после восьми движений: 1'.

findings.description: F-022: 'CREATE ONCE -> UPDATE MANY TIMES -> COMMIT' appeared in the flowchart caption and the page description with no Russian gloss anywhere in a Russian-language beginner book.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_18): both the flowchart caption and the page description now lead with 'Создать один раз → много раз обновить → зафиксировать', keeping the English mnemonic in parentheses. Verified PRESENT in regenerated HTML.
